subject: Evidence request: tenant lifecycle attestation & cross-region discard playbook
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@greenbridge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: security@greenbridge.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: evidence for tenant lifecycle & cross-region deletion controls

Hi Vivek / Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. GreenBridge procurement/security has a short list of artifacts we need to close our SOC 2 readiness review for the account we intend to onboard: 

- Per-tenant TTL mappings (where applicable) and the policy that drives TTL values
- Deletion workflow proof: a sample deletion run for a sandbox tenant (timestamps, request id, affected blob keys)
- Audit trail showing who initiated the deletion and service components that executed it
- Cross-region deletion behavior (are copies in other regions marked/garbage-collected?)
- Proof of key handling for encrypted blobs (KMS key ids and rotation notes)

We attached the questionnaire (GreenBridge_Q1_retention_questionnaire.pdf). Can you confirm what you can provide within 7 business days? Also please highlight any artifacts that are synthetic/sampled vs full exports.

Maya
Maya Singh
Security & Compliance, GreenBridge Bank
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@greenbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: evidence for tenant lifecycle & cross-region deletion controls

Hi Maya —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide all of the items you requested; a few clarifying notes so we align on scope: 

1) Tenants: please confirm whether this is for the GreenBridge production tenant only or if you also want the sandbox/staging tenant exports. If production only, we will prepare redacted samples.

2) Deletion run: we will produce a sampled deletion trace (request ID + affected objects + timestamps) from a dedicated sandbox run so no customer data is exposed. We will also include sanitized logs to show the cross-region garbage-collection pass.

3) KMS details: we can provide KMS key IDs and rotation cadence. We will not share key material.

Proposed timeline: deliverables packaged by end of week (2026-09-18). If that works, I can schedule a 30-min walkthrough on Mon 9/20 to go through the artifacts and answer questions.

Attachments: ttl-export-sample.csv (synthetic mapping sample)

Action items: Laura — please confirm the expected tenant scope; Naomi — can you prepare the deletion trace sample and cross-region GC excerpt?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: PrIyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: evidence for tenant lifecycle & cross-region deletion controls

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@greenbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: evidence for tenant lifecycle & cross-region deletion controls
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>

Team — following up on Vivek's note. Maya needs the artifacts packaged and a short walkthrough next week.

Please prepare the following by COB Monday 2026-09-20: 
- ttl-export-sample.csv (sanitized mapping of tenant -> TTL policy, include column: tenant_id_masked, policy_name, ttl_seconds, effective_date)
- deletion-trace-sample.log (one sandbox deletion run: request_id, initiating_user, start_ts, end_ts, object_keys_deleted)
- cross-region-gc-excerpt.txt (log snippet showing region tag removal / GC job correlation id)
- kms-rotation-notes.md (KMS key ids, rotation cadence, last rotation date)
- audit-trail-sample.csv (actor, action, resource, timestamp, request_id)

Notes on sanitization: mask tenant identifiers, do not include PII or customer payloads. Use the sandbox deletion job to reproduce the workflow rather than extracting production deletion events.

Rishi / Priyom — can you own artifact collection and a short README for each file describing how it was generated and any limitations? I will review before we send to GreenBridge.

Thanks,
Vivek

Attachments (to be added): deletion-trace-sample.log, cross-region-gc-excerpt.txt, kms-rotation-notes.md, audit-trail-sample.csv
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@greenbridge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: security@greenbridge.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: evidence for tenant lifecycle & cross-region deletion controls

Vivek —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. The proposed scope (production tenant with sanitized samples + sandbox deletion run) is perfect. We received the package and attached attestation request (attestation-request.docx) — could one of your compliance leads sign and return the attestation statement after the walkthrough?

We will review the artifacts ahead of the call on 2026-09-20 and may have a couple of follow-up questions on retention windows for logs vs. blobs.

Thanks,
Maya

--
Maya Singh
Security & Compliance, GreenBridge Bank
